framing_inherited: methods paper, variant B (honest open anomaly, not a detection)
purpose: Execute the isolated-referee concerns + OC-3 as real computations, converting declared caveats into frozen numbers before JCAP submission.

comparison_definition.type: like-for-like cut-sky mocks, masked filtration (Test 2, definitive)
comparison_definition.note: Empirical arrays recomputed from the 2000 frozen masked cubes with Phase 8's own extractor; means reproduce the frozen summary (drift beta1 0.04 sigma, pers1 0.12 sigma). Empirical spread is wider than the frozen summary std (beta1 445 vs 313; pers1 0.080 vs 0.044) and is the representation used from here on.

beta1_max_primary.criterion_frozen: DESI in the extreme tail with empirical p_one_sided <= 0.01 AND Gaussian-reference z < -3
beta1_max_primary.criterion_rationale: Matches the real gate8 threshold (z < -3). The earlier n_below==0 phrasing in the Script 1 code was an over-literal restatement, not gate8; it is superseded here.

sole_lower_mock.interpretation: Extreme low-Om, phantom-w0 corner of the nwLH prior; physically expected to have fewer loops. Consistent with the direction of the anomaly.

pers1_secondary.criterion_frozen: DESI not a > 3 sigma excess by empirical rank (rank_pct < 99.87)

paper_wording_action.old: DESI below all 2000 like-for-like mocks, empirical p < 1/2000
paper_wording_action.new: DESI below all but one of 2000 like-for-like mocks (rank 1/2000, empirical p ~ 1e-3); the sole lower mock is an extreme low-Om (Om~0.10), phantom-w0 (w0~-1.26) cosmology.

script2_w0_response.binned_response_note: Flat at ~35400 across the range, with a mild dip at BOTH extremes (w0~-1.25 and w0~-0.75 -> ~34970); non-monotonic, driven by prior-edge Om/s8 mixing, not by w0.
script2_w0_response.reframed_paper_sentence: Within the sampled range w0 in [-1.30, -0.70], beta1_max shows no significant dependence on w0 at fixed (Om,s8) (partial r=-0.015, p=0.836); the response slope d(beta1_max)/d(w0) is indistinguishable from zero (OLS -76, 95% CI [-1050, +929]). DESI's deficit is not reproduced by any sampled cosmology, and the flat, sign-ambiguous w0 response admits no finite linear extrapolation to DESI. We therefore report the deficit as an anomaly relative to the w0CDM (wa=0) mock suite, not as a physical exclusion of a particular w0.
script2_w0_response.gate_verdict: PASS (exclusion retracted; deficit reframed as anomaly)

script3_fiber_surrogate.method: angular fiber-collision surrogate (62" radius, removal prop. to local angular density) vs random count-matched null; beta1_max on Test 2 virial-velocity regenerated mocks.
script3_fiber_surrogate.interpretation: At all f the fiber-specific extra effect is NEGATIVE (fiber raises beta1_max vs random) - opposite to what would reduce it toward DESI. Mocks remain +7250-7290 above DESI. Fiber incompleteness cannot produce the deficit and moves the wrong way. altmtl remains the gold-standard follow-up.

script4_rsd_satellite.method: regenerate mocks varying eta_vel (satellite virial dispersion multiplier) over Munari-plausible +/-20%; span of mock mean bounds the systematic.
script4_rsd_satellite.interpretation: Satellite RSD dispersion at +/-20% shifts beta1_max by 123 loops = 1.7% of the deficit. The residual RSD asymmetry is quantified and negligible.

script5_hod_concentrated.concern: OC-3 (HOD fit minimum at log_M1 grid edge; concentrated region unexplored)
script5_hod_concentrated.method: extend log_M1 below the fitted edge (13.8 -> 13.3 = more concentrated), regenerate mocks at fixed BGS density (carve re-downsamples), recompute beta1_max.
script5_hod_concentrated.interpretation: Lowering log_M1 to 13.3 doubles the satellite count (324k->530k pre-carve) yet moves beta1_max only 247 loops toward DESI; the most concentrated HOD leaves a +6792 gap. The grid-edge minimum (OC-3) is crossed and the deficit persists - not an HOD artifact.

cross_test_consistency_note: The same low-structure mocks (e.g. pilot idx 27 ~29k, idx 16 ~33k) sit lowest across the fiber, RSD, and HOD scans; the beta1_max tail is driven by low Om/s8 cosmologies (cf. Script 1 idx 139), not by fiber/RSD/HOD nuisances. Physics is consistent across all tests.
gate9_overall_verdict: PASS - all five concerns/OC executed. beta1_max deficit survives empirical ranking (1/2000), w0 (no in-range dependence, exclusion retracted->reframed), fiber (excluded, wrong sign), RSD satellites (1.7% of deficit), and concentrated HOD (excluded). Deficit reported as an honest open anomaly, not a dark-energy detection.

phase9b_second_round_panel.note: The full three-referee second-round report (MINOR REVISION, JCAP_058P_0726.R1) is broader than the isolated-referee concerns Phase 9 addressed. Items executed below; SGC (R3.1) and several majors still pending.

script6_growth_mismatch.concern: R1.1 / R3.3 (z=0.5 snapshot vs z_eff data growth mismatch)
script6_growth_mismatch.method: paired same-seed z=0 (snap4) vs z=0.5 (snap3) cut-sky masked mocks; rate scaled to data dz.
script6_growth_mismatch.interpretation: d(beta1)/dz = -53 +/- 112 (consistent with zero); over the data offset dz~0.25 the growth offset is ~13 generators = 0.2% of the deficit. Direction matches R1's intuition (more-evolved field -> fewer diffuse generators) but magnitude negligible. The leading mundane candidate is excluded; the anomaly is strengthened. NB: to be extended to the HOD-refit occupation (R3.3).

script8_mask_robustness.method: recompute masked-filtration beta1_max on frozen DESI field + 300 mock cubes under 5 mask variants (fiducial, threshold 5%/20%, erode 1/2 voxels), identically on both sides.
script8_mask_robustness.criterion: model-free: DESI z < -3 AND rank <= 3 in every variant (absolute loop-count swing not used; it scales with masked volume).
script8_mask_robustness.fiducial_sanity: DESI reproduces frozen 28256 exactly; mock drift 0.15 sigma
script8_mask_robustness.interpretation: Anomaly survives every variant (rank 1-2/300, z -6.3 to -8.3). The fractional deficit grows under stricter thresholds (20->29%), so the fiducial mask is conservative, not inflating. Eroding the boundary does not remove the deficit -> not a boundary-skin artefact.

script7_sgc_likeforlike.method: Test 2 cut-sky masked pipeline on the SGC footprint; SGC box/cell/sigma_px/density-target recomputed self-consistently from the SGC catalogues (sigma_px 0.336 vs NGC 0.320); frozen SGC mask verified consistent (100% of SGC data inside).
script7_sgc_likeforlike.interpretation: The SGC shows a 19.1% deficit (DESI below ALL 200 mocks, z=-20), essentially identical to the NGC ~20%. Two galactic hemispheres with partially different imaging (BASS+MzLS vs DECaLS north, DECaLS south), independent masks and randoms, show the same deficit at the same amplitude. A hemisphere/imaging systematic is strongly disfavoured; the anomaly is reinforced independently of NGC imaging.

phase9b_majors_complete.note: All four light majors executed (phase9b_majors.py). No referee computational item remains open.

A_redshift_split_R1.2.interpretation: The ~16% deficit is present in both halves of the z shell (z=-23.8 and -24.2); not localised in redshift.

B_scatter_decomposition_R2.2.interpretation: At fixed cosmology the stochastic scatter is 110 (~6% of the suite variance); ~94% is cosmological, driven by Om (r=0.45), not w0 (r=-0.03). The statistic responds to cosmology yet no sampled cosmology reaches DESI -> the deficit is not absorbable by any varied parameter.

C_filtration_convention_R2.3.interpretation: Discarding vs retaining sentinel-touching generators (relative cycles) leaves the deficit unchanged; the masked filtration is a well-defined object, not a recipe.

D_imaging_split_R3.1b.interpretation: BASS+MzLS vs DECaLS beta1_max differ by 0.7%; imaging does not drive the deficit. With SGC_CONFIRMS, a selection/imaging systematic is excluded from two independent directions.
